description: Manual synonym rank projections: keep option leaf binding, inherit rank from an equivalent leaf already in the joint champion shortlist. Rules: (1) norm-label duplicate in ranking; (2) acceptable_l2 id match with label verification; (3) duplicated_across_l1 acceptable-group cross-match with label verification. Never project from ID alone when ranked leaf label diverges from acceptable entry (e.g. mxh055 B5.1=NMS).

projections.rationale: Gold bound to B3.2 Primary Hyperparathyroidism; acceptable slot B4.1 is in joint ranking as Hyperparathyroidism (rank 4).
Gold bound to B4.1 PCD; acceptable Kartagener clone B4.3 is joint rank 1 (PCD/Kartagener duplicate group).
Gold bound to B4.1 PCD; acceptable Kartagener clone B4.3 is joint rank 1 (PCD/Kartagener duplicate group).
Gold bound to B4.1 PCD; acceptable Kartagener clone B4.3 is joint rank 1 (PCD/Kartagener duplicate group).

negative_findings_summary.note: Cases like mb82/mxh045/mxh046/mxh055/mxh075 have duplicate label clones in tree, but none of those clones entered the joint shortlist — rank=None is not a synonym misjudgment.
